principles: Goals prioritize what Vitami explores; they do not independently justify a supplement recommendation.
A goal may activate additional questions or candidate rule groups.
Marketing campaigns may preselect a goal, but the scientific engine remains unchanged.
Vitami may conclude that no supplement is indicated for a selected goal.
User-facing claims must remain evidence-aware and avoid promises of treatment, prevention, rejuvenation, or guaranteed outcomes.
Family history may prioritize assessment domains but must never be treated as proof that a supplement prevents the familial condition.
